title: Search results with faceted filters, sort and pagination — general marketplace
notes: v2 replaces the left refinement column with a sticky filter bar of <details> popovers (brands re-ordered by popularity, new ids) plus a hidden 'All filters' dialog that duplicates the brand checkboxes. Sort moves into <bz-sort-menu>'s shadow root with new name/values and 'Relevance' copy. Results switch from list rows to a grid of cards with vanilla-extract hashed classes; data-asin becomes data-product-id and data-index is renumbered after re-ranking (index 4 is now a different product); the seller has also re-worded the Orsini Milano listing title. A sponsored rail repeats the Vellora Duetto with its price and an 'Add to cart' button, and a compact 'Page 1 of 20 · Next' pager is inserted above the results.
